name: jexpress
description: Orchestrates PDE AI-Work Jira tickets end-to-end (discovery, implementation, review, merge), progressing ticket status automatically and pausing at human review gates until the developer advances it.

ATLASSIAN_EMAIL.title: Atlassian email
ATLASSIAN_EMAIL.description: Email address for Atlassian/Jira API authentication.

REPOS_DIR.title: Repo clones directory
REPOS_DIR.description: Default: the orchestrator's current working directory. Absolute path to the directory containing this project's repo clones (expected as direct subfolders of it). Leave blank to use the default.

CONFLUENCE_SPACE_KEY.title: Confluence space key
CONFLUENCE_SPACE_KEY.description: Default: PDE. Confluence space where ticket artifact pages are synced. Leave blank to use the default.

CONFLUENCE_PARENT_PAGE_ID.title: Confluence parent folder/page ID
CONFLUENCE_PARENT_PAGE_ID.description: Default: 5148311567. ID of the Confluence folder or page under which each ticket's parent page is created. Leave blank to use the default.

CONFLUENCE_SYNC_ENABLED.title: Enable Confluence sync
CONFLUENCE_SYNC_ENABLED.description: Default: true (enabled). Sync ticket artifacts (discovery.md, implementation-notes.md, review-notes.md, merge-notes.md) to Confluence. Set to false to disable entirely — no self-install attempt, no warnings, and a Confluence pull failure never blocks a ticket's progress. Leave blank to use the default.

DRAFT_PR_ENABLED.title: Open PRs as draft
DRAFT_PR_ENABLED.description: Default: true (enabled). ticket-implementation opens each PR as a draft, so the ticket's assignee gets a first look before others are notified or requested to review. A human marks it ready for review in GitHub when they're satisfied; ticket-merge treats a still-draft PR as pending, not blocked. Set to false to open PRs ready for review immediately. Leave blank to use the default.
